name: Tunnel signals (Hv and Ks)
summary: Signals which are mounted to the walls in tunnels.
description: Hv and Ks tunnel signals for placement in the tunnel, available between 1978 and 1998 (Hv) and from 1998 (Ks). The signal components are required.
